_comment: Single source of truth for every Higgsfield request. hfgate.py builds prompts ONLY from this file + a segment spec. Do not paste prompt text by hand.
project: 2026 제11회 구로 청소년축제 오프닝 · 종이비행기 원테이크

pricing._finalize_source: get_cost 2026-10-02: {model,draft_job_id,resolution:1080p,prompt} on a 14s draft = 60cr. Adding mode/duration/etc made it a NEW generation (168cr) - E15. 26s/30s finalize price is extrapolated (unverified until a draft exists).

start_frame_v2.what: ONE 시작 키프레임 (완전히 접힌 다트형, 복도 레퍼런스 포함) — KF.v4 결과 중 사용자 선택본으로 교체

location_refs._rule: A location that is VISIBLE anywhere in a segment (even through a door or window) must have its reference attached (lint L2).

locks.STYLE: ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT, first frame to last: a single take with no cuts. One smooth gimbal camera keeps the airplane in view. Photorealistic live action, 16:9.
locks.PLANE: The airplane is the plain white dart from the airplane reference: crisply, completely folded from blank A4 (no print, no logo), long sharp nose, two flat identical swept-back wings, sharp creases, neat keel, never crumpled or half-folded. It flies nose first on one smooth continuous path, never jumps, flips or reverses, turns only in slow gentle curves, and never changes shape or size.
locks.LIGHT: Sunny late morning, same warm sunlight direction throughout, no flicker.
locks.classroom: Classroom = classroom reference: ivory walls, green chalkboard in front, light-wood desks, windows with white blinds on the LEFT wall, open sliding door at the FRONT-RIGHT.
locks.corridor: Corridor = corridor reference, ONE single straight corridor whose design and exposure never change, the same through the door and inside: glossy light-grey floor with sunlight stripes, tall windows facing the sports field on one side, ivory wall with doors on the other, evenly lit, never blown-out white.
locks.field: Field = field references: light-brown dirt field with white lines, white soccer goals, green trees, ivory school building, clear blue sky. Students are always small, seen from high above or behind, no recognisable faces.
locks.sky: Clear deep blue sky above the same school.

negatives_global: no teleporting, reversing or tail-first airplane
no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos

forbidden_positive_terms._rule: Words that must NOT appear in the positive (non-negative) part of a prompt — each comes from a user decision. Use 'allow_terms' in a spec to override with a reason.

terms.hand: D3 SEQ1: 손으로 날리지 않음 (바람으로 이륙)
terms.cheer: D4 SEQ3 S4: 환호 금지, 바라보며 웃기
terms.whistle: D5 SEQ3 S2: 호루라기 소리 금지
terms.pointing at: D4 (사람이 손가락질 금지; 'nose pointing toward'는 허용)
